news.t: Nations Championship: Fixtures & standings after round five
news.sum: Who is leading the Nations Championship and who plays who when?

news.t: Scotland win hard fought match against Australia
news.sum: Scotland eked out a hard-fought home 15-12 win over Australia but were unable to get the bonus point they craved in a Nations Championship match that failed to catch fire.

news.t: Final whistle a blessing as Scotland edge dull Test against Australia
news.sum: Scotland edge a dull Nations Championship encounter against Australia at Murrayfield.

news.t: Saracens leave it late to battle past Leicester
news.sum: Saracens make it three wins from three in the Prem Rugby Cup with a narrow victory at winless Leicester Tigers.

news.t: Defensive desire a Welsh hallmark - Roberts
news.sum: Former Wales centre Jamie Roberts says the heroic defensive effort to beat New Zealand for the first time since 1953 showed what it meant to be Welsh.

news.t: Ireland must improve on 'clunky' display for Boks
news.sum: Tommy O'Brien feels Ireland must improve on the "clunky" win over Fiji on Saturday when they face world champions South Africa on Saturday.

news.t: Reality dawns after Wales dared to dream
news.sum: As Welsh rugby fans wake up on Sunday morning the realisation will dawn on them that Wales beat New Zealand for the first time in 73 years.

news.t: England are favourites against All Blacks, and fearless Wales are an inspiration
news.sum: In his latest BBC Sport column, England World Cup winner Matt Dawson reflects on Steve Borthwick's side's emphatic 78-15 thrashing of Japan and looks ahead to their match against New Zealand next weekend.

news.t: Irish scrum improving but true test awaits vs the Boks
news.sum: While Ireland's scrum has been dominant in the first two games of this Nations Championship window, the true test of Ireland's setpiece is in store next week.

news.t: Fiji 'did Ireland a favour' before South Africa game
news.sum: Former South Africa head coach Jake White says his Fiji side "did Ireland a favour" in Saturday's Nations Championship match before they face the Springboks in Dublin next week.

news.t: A short but sweet Ireland cameo for Ulster's McNabney
news.sum: Ireland head coach Andy Farrell gives an update on the injury sustained by Ulster's James McNabney, who had to be replaced four minutes into his international debut in their 43-15 win against Fiji.

news.t: Ireland ratings: Porter leads strong front row showing
news.sum: Ireland warmed up for the visit of the Springboks with a 43-15 win over Fiji, a victory they were made work for after a stodgy first half display.

news.t: Beirne admits Ireland need to improve on 'clunky' display
news.sum: Ireland captain Tadhg Beirne said the team have plenty to improve upon after a "clunky" display against Fiji, with world champions South Africa arriving in Dublin next weekend.

news.t: Baloucoune double as Ireland cruise past Fiji
news.sum: Ulster wing Rob Baloucoune scores two tries in Ireland's 43-15 victory over Fiji in the Nations Championship at the Aviva Stadium.

news.t: Watch: Seven-try Ireland secure win over Fiji
news.sum: Watch the tries as Ireland secure a 43-15 victory over Fiji in the Nations Championship in Dublin.

news.t: Farrell admits scoreline 'flattered' Ireland in Fiji win

news.t: Ireland shake off sluggish start to brush aside Fiji
news.sum: Ireland recover from a sluggish first-half performance to wear down spirited Fiji and keep alive their hopes of topping the Nations Championship northern hemisphere table.

news.t: Second half flurry gives Ireland unconvincing win v Fiji
news.sum: Ireland warmed up for next week's visit of South Africa with a 43-15 bonus-point win against Fiji, but Andy Farrell's side will need a significant improvement when the world champions come to town next week.

news.t: Rugby Union Weekly: The greatest win in Welsh rugby history?
news.sum: Reaction to Wales' first victory over New Zealand since 1953 and England thrashing Japan.

news.t: Comeback kid Joseph thrills as England eye All Blacks
news.sum: Will Joseph's comeback after four years off the Test scene was worth waiting for. And there was plenty elsewhere to buoy England in a rout of Japan.

news.t: 'One of the greatest wins' - Wales stun All Blacks to go from no-hopers to heroes
news.sum: Wales end a 73-year hoodoo against New Zealand with a win hailed as their greatest of all time.

news.t: Joseph enjoys dream return as England thrash Japan at Twickenham

news.t: Nations Championship recap: Ireland 43-15 Fiji
news.sum: Ireland got the better of Fiji at Aviva Stadium but it was a far from convincing performance.

news.t: Joseph scores record-equalling five tries as England rout Japan
news.sum: Will Joseph marked his comeback after four years out the Test game with a record-equalling five tries as England tore through Japan.

news.t: Wales believed they could create history - Lake
news.sum: Captain Dewi Lake says he always believed Wales could defeat New Zealand and end the 73-year hoodoo against the All Blacks.

news.t: All Blacks ran into a Welsh brick wall - Barrett
news.sum: New Zealand captain Beauden Barrett praises Wales' brick wall defence after the All Blacks are stunned in Cardiff.

news.t: Quins win again in cup as Gloucester also triumph
news.sum: Gloucester win at Bath and Harlequins maintain their 100% record in the Prem Rugby Cup.

news.t: Magnificent Wales beat New Zealand for first time since 1953
news.sum: Wales celebrate a first victory against New Zealand since 1953 with a brilliant 35-28 win to spark astonishing scenes in Cardiff.

news.t: Highlights: Wales beat New Zealand for first time in 73 years
news.sum: Watch the best of the action as Wales beat New Zealand for the first time in 73 years

news.t: Wales end 73-year wait with epic victory over All Blacks
news.sum: Wales ended 73 years of hurt against New Zealand and shredded world rugby's form book by winning an epic Nations Championship encounter 35-28 at the Principality Stadium.

news.t: France edge past South Africa after thriller in Nations Championship
news.sum: France hold their nerve to beat South Africa by just two points, winning 21-19 at the Stade de France, to make it four wins from five in the Nations Championship and putting the home side in a strong position to top the

news.t: France hold nerve to edge past South Africa in thriller
news.sum: France hold on to end their five-match losing run against South Africa at Stade de France with an enthralling 21-19 victory in Paris.

news.t: Dupont guides France to nail-biting win over South Africa
news.sum: France put one foot in the inaugural Nations Championship final after an enthralling 21-19 victory over South Africa in Stade de France.

news.t: Beirne leads Ireland bid to build on strong start
news.sum: Tadhg Beirne, so often Ireland's 'Mr Dependable', leads the team's bid to improve on last week's win over Argentina against Fiji on Saturday.

news.t: England fly-half Harrison signs new Saracens deal
news.sum: England fly-half Zoe Harrison renews her contract with Saracens for the forthcoming Premiership Women's Rugby campaign.

news.t: 'You would have worried for the horses!' - Farrell on McNabney
news.sum: Ireland head coach Andy Farrell pays tribute to James McNabney who is in line to win his first international cap against Fiji on Saturday.

news.t: Beirne: Argentina win has to be 'foundation' for growth
news.sum: Tadhg Beirne insists Ireland will not rest on their laurels as he prepares to captain his country in Dublin for the first time in Saturday's Nations Championship clash with Fiji.

news.t: Mulhall Rock back with Tinahely after Rugby 7s tenure
news.sum: After being away from the competitive arena for an extended period of time, former Ireland Women's 7s rugby captain Lucy Mulhall Rock has enjoyed being back out on a Gaelic football pitch with her native Tinahely in Wick

news.t: Ireland look to build on good start as Fiji come to town
news.sum: Depending on which direction you look, Andy Farrell has either rotated heavily or not rotated enough for this evening's meeting with Fiji at Aviva Stadium, writes Neil Treacy.

news.t: Baird mastering his craft after 'soul-sapping' injuries
news.sum: This time last year, everything was coming together for Ryan Baird, before two broken legs turned his season upside down, writes Neil Treacy.

news.t: The driving-maul try machine - why rugby's steamroller gained traction
news.sum: A kick to the corner is now a no-brainer for captains, with the driving maul a more potent weapon than ever.

news.t: Lenihan: Nothing experimental about XV to face Fiji
news.sum: Donal Lenihan sees much logic in the team that Andy Farrell has picked for the clash with Fiji.

news.t: Fight for Ireland place 'a great thing' for Ryan
news.sum: Ireland second row James Ryan believes the competition for places is "a great thing" as Andy Farrell's side prepare to face Fiji in the Nations Championship in Dublin on Saturday.

news.t: McNabney rise a 'phenomenal story' - Farrell
news.sum: Ireland head coach Andy Farrell says James McNabney's route to the Ireland set-up is a "phenomenal story" ahead of the Ulster back row being named among the replacements for Saturday's Nations Championship match against

news.t: 'Full steam ahead' as Ireland aim to lay down a mark
news.sum: Last week, Andy Farrell was blunt in his assessment that if the tournament was happening right now, his side couldn't be contenders, but he still believes time is on their side to travel to Australia as potential winners

news.t: How and why Wales are relying on scrum-half Williams
news.sum: Wales head coach Steve Tandy says is a big demand on the workload of scrum-half Tomos Williams.

news.t: Farrell backs McNabney to make his mark on Test rugby
news.sum: Andy Farrell believes Ulster's James McNabney is ready to make the step up to Test level, after naming the 23-year-old in his squad for Saturday's Nations Championship meeting with Fiji.

news.t: McNabney set for debut as Irish make seven changes
news.sum: Ulster's James McNabney is poised to make his Ireland debut off the bench as head coach Andy Farrell makes seven changes for Saturday's Nations Championship match against Fiji.

news.t: Ireland v Fiji: All You Need to Know
news.sum: Round five of the Nations Championship is swiftly upon us, and eight days on from their comprehensive 42-12 win over Argentina, Andy Farrell's Ireland welcome Fiji to Dublin.

news.t: Beirne captains Ireland, Timoney starts at 8 v Fiji
news.sum: Tadhg Beirne will captain Ireland in Saturday's Nations Championship meeting with Fiji, while Nick Timoney has won the race to start at number 8 in the absence of Sean Jansen.

news.t: Ryan: 'We're not thinking about South Africa'
news.sum: James Ryan insists Ireland are solely focused on Fiji, despite a crunch tie with South Africa looming next week.

news.t: Nations Championship: England recall Ford, Dupont at 10
news.sum: Steve Borthwick has opted to recall George Ford at out-half for Saturday's Nations Championship clash with Japan (4.40pm), in one of ten changes to their starting side.

news.t: 'We played the Traitors and I was terrible!'
news.sum: Joey Carbery admits he was "terrible" at the Traitors when the Leinster squad played the game in South Africa earlier this season.

news.t: Gibson-Park raring to go after disrupted start to season
news.sum: After a groin injury delayed his start to the season, Jamison Gibson-Park is excited to be "back in the mix" as he looks to kickstart his campaign.

news.t: 'It's what I want' - Carbery outlines Ireland dream
news.sum: In an interview with the Ireland Rugby Social, Joey Carbery outlines his international ambitions, recalls his Munster exit and speaks about incoming Leinster boss Noel McNamara.

news.t: The Ireland Rugby Social Podcast
news.sum: Joey Carbery on Ireland, France, his Leinster return, The Traitors and what's next.

news.t: Irish workrate, backrow calls, and the hybrid player era
news.sum: Neil Treacy is joined by Johne Murphy and Hugh Hogan on this week's RTÉ Rugby podcast, as we recap the big talking points from Ireland's 42-12 Nations Championship win against Argentina last week.

news.t: Ireland 'won't get into arm wrestle' with Fiji
news.sum: Ireland centre Stuart McCloskey says Andy Farrell's side will not be drawn into an arm wrestle with Fiji in Saturday's Nations Championship game in Dublin.

news.t: Best calls for calm after winless Ulster start
news.sum: Ulster general manager Rory Best says "there's not a huge panic from my point of view" despite the province's winless start to the URC season.

news.t: Ulster's Timoney 'grateful' for Ireland chances
news.sum: Nick Timoney tells the BBC's Ireland Rugby Social podcast that he is relishing being a regular part of Ireland's matchday squads after having to be patient for his opportunities.
